study.question: Does the auxiliary-derived scalar angle retained by the best nuisance-exclusion transfer affect click validation AUC beyond its retained auxiliary radius, orientation bit and support, and does that effect interact with external sign?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent retains auxiliary information in |<O,E>|/||O|| even after replacing the excluded auxiliary line by a coordinate nuisance line. This scalar tilts H in the E/U plane and changes the normalized context update direction. If that angle matters to the local gain, replacing it with a prespecified pi/4 tilt at the same radius and transported orientation bit will change click AUC. Utility of the native angle is unverified; the null and an improved replacement are admissible. This tests scalar-angle dependence, not whether auxiliary labels as a whole are necessary.

study.proposed_difference: Add stateless _fixed_angle_nuisance_line. With E=unit(F projected out of centered click K) and U=unit(the existing coordinate nuisance projected out of K/F), construct H45=||O||*(E+U)/sqrt(2). Project F out of K/H45 using the inherited two-pass tangent helper; renormalize its result to ||O||; canonicalize its line and attach the original Q pivot bit s(Q). Require the inherited nuisance line active and new reference/nuisance/direction valid, otherwise output zero with no fallback. Compute this helper and both signs in all four standalone cells. A new orthogonal_assignment selects native or fixed angle; orthogonal_orientation supplies external +/- sign. No changed learned modules, labels, histories, task masks or inference operations. Scalar auxiliary radius, original validity, Q bit and trajectory dependence are intentionally retained.
predictions: At identical forward state, all train/eval probabilities, learned/buffer state, all ordinary private gradients, scalar BCE and host RNG match across cells. Only the collected shared-context VJP may differ.

Before cast, new transfer is occupied-row centered, zero on empty rows, orthogonal to centered K and H45, and has ||O|| on valid native support. Its H45 absolute cosine with E is 1/sqrt(2) up to FP64 roundoff. External signs have identical norms/support and opposite transfer.

Host should measure native |<O,E>|/||O||, new cosine, all zero/near-zero gate rates and support mismatches, norm errors, K/H overlaps and pivot ties/sign frequencies. Check all-empty, one-occupied, zero-K, zero-O and near-degenerate cases plus repeated IDs and post-cast/scatter residuals.

falsifiers: Native-angle click advantage at both signs is absent or reverses with valid geometry/support and replay, falsifying necessity of native angle for these implementations.
New outputs or private gradients/state/forward differ at identical state beyond the declared collected VJP, invalidating the isolated-control interpretation.
New gate activity differs materially from inherited support, radius matching fails or H45 geometry fails: this is an implementation/control failure, not evidence against auxiliary angle utility.
Native bridges fail their exact deterministic replay: suspend any cross-round causal interpretation and diagnose arithmetic/execution before selecting a result.
A native advantage without a matched constant typical-angle control cannot establish information-specific utility; a single seed cannot establish repeated support.
alternative_explanations: Native angle may merely impose a favorable static tilt, while pi/4 introduces a large arbitrary perturbation; this experiment does not separate native batch variation from mean geometry.
Auxiliary radius, sign bit, original O-dependent validity and private true-label graphs remain useful even if the tested angle is unnecessary.
The native-minus-click-bit negative AUC difference is only0.0001247403017386, and may reflect frozen-seed optimization or validation selection rather than robust supervision value.
Near-max pivot ties, sparse repeated-ID accumulation, casts and adaptive optimizers can magnify tiny direction changes.
Auxiliary labels match category/brand within24h and historical official_offline action maturity is not established; transfer claims are confined to the frozen offline benchmark.
